text:
Neon is the backend for apps and agents.

Start with a quick setup prompt, or follow a guided tutorial to build the full Neon stack step by step.

AI-guided setup. Creates a project, applies your schema, and writes a .env in one step. Copy the prompt below and get started.

Next.js on the full Neon backend: Lakebase Postgres, Auth, Object Storage, and AI Gateway, from create-next-app to deployed.

Learn how Lakebase Postgres, Managed Better Auth, Object Storage, Functions, and the AI Gateway connect across a real project, and where each one lives in your codebase.

Build backends for web apps and agents with Lakebase Postgres, Auth, Object Storage, and AI Gateway. Every service is agent-ready: instant, branchable, and serverless.

Lakebase PostgresServerless Postgres with branching, autoscaling, scale to zero, and instant restore.

Serverless Postgres with branching, autoscaling, scale to zero, and instant restore.

AuthManaged Better Auth with sign-up, OAuth, and sessions. Users live in your Postgres and branch with it.

Managed Better Auth with sign-up, OAuth, and sessions. Users live in your Postgres and branch with it.

Data APIHTTPS queries with no backend code. Drop-in compatible with Supabase.

HTTPS queries with no backend code. Drop-in compatible with Supabase.

BetaObject StorageS3-compatible object storage that branches with your database.

S3-compatible object storage that branches with your database.

BetaFunctionsLong-running serverless functions on Node.js, deployed alongside your database.

Long-running serverless functions on Node.js, deployed alongside your database.

BetaAI GatewayOne API for frontier and open-source models, built into your Neon project.

One API for frontier and open-source models, built into your Neon project.
